description: Hosting of a United Nations World Youth Conference
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-25
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to host a United Nations World Youth Conference in 2014, in Sri Lanka and to proceed with the work pertaining to same, was approved by the Cabinet.
